user.title: New station
user.description: A station groups the devices that are built into one piece of furniture. Every device or entity that carries the station's label is part of the station. Leave the label empty to create a new label called "Station <name>".

data_description.label_id: Use an existing label, or leave empty to create one.
data_description.use_power_labels: Use labels to mark what in this station is switched on and off by the station's Power on and Power off.

power_labels.title: Power labels
power_labels.description: Power on and Power off act on everything in {station} that carries the power labels.

data_description.use_default_power_labels: Mark what to switch with the labels "Power on" and "Power off". They are created if they don't exist yet. Switch off to choose your own labels.

choose_power_labels.title: Choose power labels
choose_power_labels.description: Power on switches on everything in {station} with the first label, presses labelled buttons and runs labelled scripts and scenes. Power off does the same with the second label. When the second label is empty or nothing has it, Power off switches off what Power on switched on.

data_description.power_on_label: Power on: everything in the station with this label is switched on.
data_description.power_off_label: Power off: everything in the station with this label is switched off. Can be left empty.

error.label_in_use: This label is already used by station {station}. Choose another label.
error.name_label_in_use: A label with this name is already used by station {station}. Choose a label, or use another name.

abort.already_configured: This label already belongs to another station.

init.title: Station label
init.description: Devices and entities with this label belong to the station.

error.label_in_use: This label is already used by station {station}. Choose another label.
